prose: Critic is a Show HN project whose pitch is 'review code with the agent that wrote it'. Its site shows a change narrative for keeping agent questions alive across disconnects: the system can enqueue a question while every author device is offline, exactly one connected device owns a question at a time, and a lost device's work returns after 45 seconds without losing the thread.
highlights: Show HN: Critic - review code with the agent that wrote it
Keeps agent questions alive across device disconnects
One connected device owns a question; lost work returns after 45s
